title: mq.stack-compatibility.v1
description: Read-only compatibility assessment across MQ stack repositories. Reports declared, locked and mutually compatible dependency versions with provenance. Never modifies dependencies, lockfiles or working trees.

status.description: Worst status across all components and relationships.

mode.description: static reads declared and locked versions only. fresh-resolve additionally resolves in a temporary environment.

next_action.description: Single recommended next step. Empty when status is PASS.

severity.description: Findings never carry PASS; absence of findings is the pass signal. SKIPPED records something this gate does not cover, such as a repo with no Python dependency source — distinct from UNAVAILABLE, which means the check itself could not run.

code.description: Stable finding codes. Codes are append-only within v1.

provenance.description: Where an observed value came from. Required on every dependency observation.

file.description: Repository-relative path. Absolute or home paths must not be emitted.

declared.description: Declared version specifier, or null when not declared.

locked.description: Locked concrete version, or null when no lockfile pins it.

installed.description: Version installed in the active environment, when observed.

resolved.description: Version a fresh resolution selected. Only populated in fresh-resolve mode.

bounded.description: True when the declared range excludes the next major version.

critical.description: True when the stack has named this dependency as protocol-critical, in a repo contract's compatibility block. Critical dependencies additionally raise unbounded-range and missing-metadata warnings; dependencies discovered only by being shared between repos are assessed for proven pairwise incompatibility alone.

version.description: Repository version, or null when unavailable.

requires_python.description: The repository's declared requires-python. A fresh resolution targets it rather than the interpreter running the gate.

import_probes.description: Critical imports probed against freshly resolved versions, e.g. {"mcp": "from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP"}. Declared by the repository; a default applies until it does.

compatibility_declared.description: Whether the repo contract carries a compatibility block. False means the metadata is missing, which is non-blocking during rollout.

produces.description: MQ contracts this repo declares it produces.

consumes.description: MQ contracts this repo declares it consumes.

reason.description: Why this component is SKIPPED or UNAVAILABLE.

subject.description: Shared dependency or protocol under assessment.

overlap.description: Whether the declared ranges intersect. Null when undetermined.

repos.description: Every repository the finding implicates. Absent when that is exactly the one named in `repo`.

blocks_release.description: True for FAIL findings. WARN and UNAVAILABLE never block on their own.
